title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ‘Building Resilient Inclusive and accountable Communities in Zimbabwe (BRIC- Zim)’ project in Gutu, Buhera, Zvishavane, Matobo, Mberengwa and Harare in Zimbabwe, implemented by Oxfam through ICSP will reach 18,900 people directly and include women, youth and PLWDs from communities prone to climate shocks and natural disasters. Oxfam will work with 6 local NGO partners to assist vulnerable communities to move from protracted food insecurity crisis to an improved state where women, men and children are resilient and less dependent on humanitarian assistance in the face of climate shocks. Other areas of work will include addressing GBV and realising rights in vulnerable communities. The focus of Impact 3 is on building the capacity of local actors to undertake humanitarian responses and linking them to decision making spaces. Ultimately, ICSP intends to deliver on increased participation, representation and leadership of local actors in decision making platforms at district and regional levels and enhance humanitarian response and local leadership.
